text:
devon: FYI — I will kick off a non-critical canary for the telemetry ingestion change tonight at 23:00 UTC. Handing off oncall coverage + watchers. Not expecting a large risk but want eyes on latency and 5xxs.

devon: Plan/high level:
- Canary: start 10% traffic to telemetry-v2, ramp to 25% then 100% over ~30m if healthy.
- Freeze window: 22:30–00:30 UTC (please hold other deploys).
- Primary watch metrics: error_rate, p95 latency (/telemetry/ingest), pod restart_count, queue length.
- Auto-rollback: enabled on error_rate > 0.5% sustained 5m or pod restart_count spikes.
- Known risk: initial KV cache flush could surface transient 502s for ~30s during first ramp.

mike_oncall: I'm oncall 22:00–06:00 UTC, I'll be the primary watcher for the canary. Ping me if p95 > 200ms or error rate crosses 0.3% (I'll escalate at 0.5%).

sara_pm: Thanks — I'll be standby for product/regression checks. If quality drops (relevant evals failing) we pause and rollback. Agreed on the 0.5% threshold.

jessica_se: Quick preflight: make sure env var ENABLE_TELEMETRY=true in canary. Also run the smoke curl before/after ramp: `curl -v -H "Content-Type: application/json" https://api.internal/telemetry/ingest -d @tests/sample_event.json` — sample payload in #eng-qa.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by devon for 2026-10-01T23:00Z. Canary policy: 10% -> 25% -> 100% (30m). Auto-rollback: ON. Watchers notified.

alex_infra: Infra note: watch node pressure during the ramp (NVIDIA mem hot spots). Rule: if restart_count > 3 for any canary pod in 10m, trigger manual rollback. Quick check: `kubectl -n canary get pods -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,RESTARTS:.status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount`

tim_ops: I'm available for infra rollback. If we need manual rollback run: `redeploy --rollback telemetry-canary-v2` or `k apply -f rollout/rollback-canary.yaml`. My cell is +1-555-0123 if you need a quick pager.

devon: Handoff summary: mike primary, alex backup infra, tim available for manual rollback, sara on product checks, jessica on smoke/tests. I've added console watchers on the telemetry-canary dashboard (/console/dashboards/telemetry-canary). I'll be briefly offline 00:15–00:45 UTC (personal) — mike please cover alerts during that window.

mike_oncall: Ack. Adding a hard freeze for other teams 22:30–00:30 UTC — please don't schedule merges/deploys to services that touch telemetry. :no_entry_sign:

sara_pm: Noted, I'll block merges in the relevant repos and update the release calendar. Also reminder: DB migrations are blocked until canary reaches 100% and we confirm no regressions.

jessica_se: Tests: I left a small eval set under the canary run. If quality regresses by > 5% on the evaluation prompts, tag @sara_pm and mark for rollback.

devon: Thanks everyone. I'll post a short smoke result once the 10% canary completes. If you see sustained 5xx or an increase in p95 > 2x baseline, escalate and rollback.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 1951239985 — observers: mike_oncall, alex_infra, sara_pm, jessica_se.

mike_oncall: Watching now. First 10m looks ok (no spike). Keeping channel open for next ramp.

devon: Closing handoff notes here — I'll follow up with a brief post-run summary in the morning. Thanks!
